objective.meaning: 月3倍は元本20万円を30暦日で60万円へ増やすこと。利益保証ではなく、必要条件と再現可能な経路を検証する。

problem_contract.as_is: 修正済み64日系VALIDATIONは費用後プラスだが、既存モデルはALL_TRADESをSKIPして勝ち取引を捨て、ライブラリは事後検算に留まり、機会数・資本効率・出口寄与を一つの成長経路へ接続していない。
problem_contract.desired: ALL_TRADESを常時基準に残し、decision-time情報は取引拒否ではなく配分倍率に使い、機会数・1取引edge・資本効率が月3倍へどう寄与するかを同じ会計正本で示す。
problem_contract.counter_hypothesis: 費用後プラスは一期間の偶然で、TRAINから固定した配分はVALIDATIONで増分を作らず、月3倍に必要な倍率はDD・証拠金・破産制約を破る。
problem_contract.success: TRAINだけで固定した少なくとも一つのmodifierがVALIDATIONでbaselineを上回り、paired LCBが正、PF>1、実現DD<=30%、cohort-only margin cap<=75%、かつ少なくとも一つの30日窓で3倍へ到達する。
problem_contract.partial_success: 月3倍未達でも、費用後増分が正で、月3倍への不足を機会数・edge・資本効率へ一意に分解できる。
problem_contract.fail_closed: 結果後のpolicy選択、未来outcomeを使う倍率、欠測0化、mid fill、未配賦cashflow、証拠金超過、破産後継続は無効。

cohort.membership: existing ALL_TRADES 60/40 chronological TRAIN/VALIDATION rows with 1h embargo; purge rows excluded
cohort.label: corrected_actual_after_cost_net_jpy from TRADE_CASHFLOW_FINANCIAL_ORACLE_V2

policies.INVENTORY_CAP_V2_RELABELED: existing frozen 0.5/1.0 decision multiplier, joined to corrected V2 cashflow
policies.TECHNICAL_DISSENT_CAP_V3_RELABELED: existing frozen 0.5/1.0 decision multiplier, joined to corrected V2 cashflow
policies.GROUP_RELATIVE_SIZE: TRAIN-only pair/side/regime normalized-return empirical-Bayes score with prior weight 20; group n<8 uses global score; score rank maps continuously to [0.5,1.5]; never SKIP
policies.PRICE_ACTION_RIDGE_SIZE: TRAIN-only Ridge(alpha=10) on standardized decision-time price-action features predicting corrected JPY per 1000 units; TRAIN 33/67 percentiles map to 0.5/1.0/1.5; missing features pass through at 1.0; never SKIP
policies.FUSED_SIZE: arithmetic mean of GROUP_RELATIVE_SIZE and PRICE_ACTION_RIDGE_SIZE clipped to [0.5,1.5]; inventory and technical caps remain separate ablations

growth_grid.selection: Evaluate the entire preregistered sparse grid. TRAIN marks connected feasible plateaus; VALIDATION reports every frozen point and may not choose a new threshold.
growth_grid.execution_shadow: cashflow and initial margin scale linearly with units; fractional multiplier is diagnostic. Existing broker fill prices are preserved; no extra opportunities are invented.
growth_grid.portfolio_order: process entries and closes by exact UTC; only already-realized cashflow changes decision-time equity; open cohort margin consumes the cap
growth_grid.ruin: stop a path at equity<=0; never continue after ruin

train_plateau_gate.connectedness: the same policy must have at least one adjacent feasible risk_scale or margin-cap grid point
train_plateau_gate.validation: only exact TRAIN-connected points are admission candidates; all other frozen points remain diagnostics

known_limits: Cohort-only margin excludes manual/tagless and external inventory.
Realized-close drawdown is not mark-to-market drawdown; path MAE is incomplete.
Linear unit scaling is a shadow assumption and does not prove depth/partial-fill at larger size.
This phase cannot create new independent opportunities; it measures the opportunity multiplier still required.
